Package com.kerosene.kfe.messaging.adapters.out.persistence

Class KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.messaging.adapters.out.persistence.KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxService
@Service public class KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxService extends Object
Persists financial notification events and coordinates idempotent enqueue, fenced worker claims, retry scheduling, dead-letter transitions, and delivery acknowledgement.

  • Method Details

    • enqueue

      @Transactional(propagation=MANDATORY) public KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxEntity enqueue(MessageEnvelope message, long userId, UUID transactionId)
      Enqueues a versioned message envelope once per message ID, returning the existing row on replay. A unique-key race is resolved by reloading the winner after flush.
      Parameters:
      message - validated message envelope carrying event and trace identity
      userId - positive notification recipient
      transactionId - associated financial transaction, if any
      Returns:
      existing or newly persisted outbox record

    • claimDue

      @Transactional public List<KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxEntity> claimDue(String workerId)
      Claims at most 100 due rows using a five-minute lease and per-row fencing token. Candidate selection and update are fenced in persistence so concurrent workers cannot own the same live claim; expired leases become eligible for later recovery.
      Parameters:
      workerId - diagnostic owner label, normalized and length-limited
      Returns:
      immutable list of rows successfully claimed by this invocation

    • enqueue

      @Transactional(propagation=MANDATORY) public KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxEntity enqueue(UUID eventId, Long userId, UUID transactionId, String eventType, Map<String,?> payload)
      Enqueues a financial event in the caller's transaction without a uniqueness-error rollback.

    • stableEventId

      public UUID stableEventId(String eventType, UUID transactionId, String discriminator)
      Derives a deterministic name-based UUID so repeated producers converge on one outbox event.
      Parameters:
      eventType - event category
      transactionId - transaction or aggregate identifier
      discriminator - event-specific stable suffix
      Returns:
      deterministic UUID from the UTF-8 composite key

    • markRetryableFailure

      @Transactional public void markRetryableFailure(UUID outboxId, int attempts, String lastError)
      Schedules an unclaimed compatibility row for retry using exponential delay.
      Parameters:
      outboxId - row to retry
      attempts - number of attempts after this failure
      lastError - persistence detail supplied by the legacy caller

    • markRetryableFailure

      @Transactional public boolean markRetryableFailure(KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxService.NotificationClaim claim, int attempts, String ignoredError)
      Fenced retry transition that stores a fixed safe error and rejects stale lease tokens.
      Parameters:
      claim - current row/token ownership
      attempts - number of attempts after this failure
      ignoredError - caller detail intentionally ignored to avoid persisting sensitive provider data
      Returns:
      true when the row was transitioned by this claim
